provenance.procedure: GET /series/12345/episodes/default?page=0 with a Bearer token; synthesised from the published v4 episodes contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tvdb episodes against a real key.
provenance.note: Synthesised: a two-episode season in default (aired) order. links.next is null, so the client stops after one page. Fields beyond those the client reads (id, name, aired, seasonNumber, number) are omitted deliberately — the client tolerates extra fields but the corpus should only assert what it consumes.
